Because I haven't been under a rock for the past week, I have seen this term thrown around plenty, but I don't have any clue what the difference between "banned" and "shadowbanned" is.

Shadowban means being banned without being notified. You can still post, comment, etc. but your posts and comments are only visible to you, and your profile is no longer visible to anybody else.

It was originally reddit's way of combating spambots, but they started using it on real users, and now they're just plain abusing it for censorship.
So how do people find out they've been shadowbanned?
Pretty sure you can only find out if a mod tells you.

No I was shadow banned once by mistake. You can tell by going to your account page and logging off. Suddenly it will say error no page. Also and sub you try to start will automatically be shut down saying that it tripped a spam detection.

/r/shadowbanned

You post there and someone alerts you if you are or aren't shadowbanned.

Banned is when you are banned from somewhere but you know that you are banned from there and probably why.

Shadowbanned is when you don't know you are banned. You can post stuff but no one can see and no one can view your account. This can lead to you being unaware that you have been banned for a long time.

Just like the title says, I need to pick up a headset for the PS4 that E3 just convinced me to buy. Im coming over from the Xbox360, Ive already borrowed my friends PS4 so I know its what I want, but I dont have a compatible headset for online play.

So, I figured Id ask here instead of that other website, what does Voat consider good? I dont need super high end $500 cans, just something with decent sound and a good mic. Comparable to say, Turtle Beach X12s, which I used on my 360 that got moved to the PC when I abandoned it.
Can I get a recommendation on a headset?

The Sony wireless gold headset is fine, it's what I use. The mic quality is good and it has virtual surround.. The only downside is the battery life, sony claims 8 hours but I charge mine every night so I don't notice it, or you can charge it while you use it. Im one of those people that has a $300 Sennheiser headset, and I find the sony gold to hold up pretty well. I like that it lets you balance the ingame audio with the mic volume.

I second this. I have the official wireless headset as well and have never had any problems out of it. Great audio and the mic is fantastic, plus no cables to deal with. I charge mine after every play session. Out of the 3 years I have owned it I have maybe ran out of juice gaming once.
Killer. Thanks, Ill start looking for a bundle pack with the gold headset.
Have you considered the Silver one, it is the wired version of the gold. Also you can use regular headphones and run the audio through the controller.

I did after I started looking for bundles with the gold headset. Im not opposed to wired, especially if its cheaper. I need them more for the mic than I do the sound, but better sound is always a plus.
Will any ol' set of USB wired 7.1 headphones work on a PS4?
I honestly couldn't tell you. I'd research online and see what you can dig up regarding it USB headsets.
I'm seeing a consensus around Yes, but I thought I'd ask other PS4 players to get a second opinion.

I can second this. I was coming from using a Tritton 720+ on Xbox360 & was very hesitant on buying the gold headset for the PS4. Having owned it now for roughly 4 months I can say I'm very happy with my purchase. I do plug them in to charge after each session as the battery life is right between 5 - 6 hours. Most of my gaming sessions only last 3 - 4 hours max so it's never really been much of a hindrance. I really like that you can load custom sound profiles to the secondary operation mode using an app on the PS4. The mic quality is superb & the virtual 5.1 surround sound works well. There's very little noise, if at all. For the price I'm amazed at the quality these headphones output. The only other thing I can say is make certain to have the earphone with the buttons on your left ear. If you put it on your right the hidden mic won't function properly & people will say you sound very faint.
